scheme_name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Equipment in Non-Tribal Areas
other_conditions: Applicant must be involved in inland fisheries activities (individual, society, self‑help group, association, reservoir monopoly, private unit, etc.).
Applicant must own private land or have a lease for land to be eligible for new pond construction assistance (if multiple landholders, consent forms of other landholders must be submitted).
Applicant must have his own bank account.
benefits_summary: Provides subsidies (40%‑90%) for fish seed production, pond construction, and a range of fisheries equipment and inputs to eligible fishermen in Gujarat.
